title: Check-in sheet
goal: Build a check-in sheet web app. The server holds three people, Ada, Ben and Cy, each with a name and whether they are present; all are absent at first. They are created the first time the list is requested and never duplicated. The page shows a table with one row per person: the name, the status as "NAME: absent" or "NAME: present", and a button labelled "Check in NAME". Clicking the button marks that person present on the server and the row shows "NAME: present". The stored status is shown when the page loads. Statuses are kept when the server restarts.
